findings.reason: the done-when can pass on exactly the population that needs the fix, so the node ships a stale-vector store while reporting success; the plan needs to state that an absent hash is treated as differing (or re-embed by `IS NULL OR <>`).
findings.text: §5's done-when measures "a census over all FacilitySignal nodes [that] finds none whose `embedded_text_hash` differs from the hash of its current embed text", but `embedded_text_hash` does not exist today (grep for it returns nothing), so every pre-existing node carries a null hash when the writer lands; a Cypher `< >` comparison against a null property is NULL, not true, so a census and a re-embed predicate written as `WHERE s.embedded_text_hash <> $hash` silently drop every null-hash node and the census passes with the stale vectors §5 exists to repair
